predictor_input.status: STAGED or IN_PROGRESS; completed handled by execution adapter
predictor_input.nominal_duration: original author polyline length / 2 metres per second
predictor_input.elapsed: time since actual public START; STAGED is zero, dependency WAIT excluded

predictor_output.remaining_time: finite nonnegative cost prediction, not a safety bound
predictor_output.future_duration_ratio: finite positive multiplier for original nominal future actions

position_fusion: Current occurrence delivered POSITION overrides residual with R18 linear all-history projection; future ratio remains predictor output; no joint posterior claim

new_candidate_fields.legal_boundary_group_count: reachable author switchable AND within-horizon groups, with every forward/reverse head STAGED
new_candidate_fields.legal_boundary_group_ids: public group IDs supporting the count
new_candidate_fields.boundary_path_time_min: minimum predicted path completion time from current vertex to a reachable candidate tail; ignores AND waits, not true ETA
new_candidate_fields.blocked_frontier_count: distinct other agents whose currently blocked cursor is reachable in current active DAG
new_candidate_fields.blocked_frontier_agents: public agent IDs supporting the count
new_candidate_fields.direct_blocked_frontier_count: same frontier restricted to one outgoing edge

policy_contract: plain dict -> list[agent_id]; [] is explicit STOP; inherited budget and active-only validation
evidence_bridge: EvidenceStore.get_graph(ref) losslessly reconstructs graph_snapshot; expand_episode restores initial_graph and gate.public_snapshot for independent audits
